period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); comparator column is 31.12.2011. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2012 (9-month, Jan-Sep). CONSOLIDATED basis, NOT Solo -- this bank's interim quarterly/half-yearly filings for FY2011-FY2015(Q1) were published ONLY on a Consolidated basis (Standard Bank Limited and its subsidiaries: Standard Exchange Co. (UK) Ltd., Standard Co. (USA) Inc., SBL Capital Management Ltd., and from 2012/2013 onward Standard Bank Securities Ltd.); no separate Solo statement exists in the interim filing format used during this period (confirmed by exhaustively reading every page of each filing -- these are either a single condensed page or a short multi-page filing containing exactly one Balance Sheet/P&L, always headed 'Consolidated'). This differs from the main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is Solo throughout. Flagged per project convention for interim/annual basis mismatches (cf. PREMIERBAN, TRUSTBANK, DHAKABANK, PRIMEBANK, ALARABANK in _HANDOFF.md). Cross-check: this quarter's own comparator column for the prior Dec-31 is Consolidated and will therefore be slightly ABOVE (not equal to) this dataset's own Solo Q4 figure for the same date -- this is expected, not an error. pdftotext extraction was clean for the Balance Sheet; the P&L table was garbled by a complex multi-column layout but core totals (operating income, operating expenses, profit before provision, PAT) are independently legible and cross-check exactly against this bank's own FY2013-Q1 filing's comparator column (Net Profit after Taxation Jan-Sep-2012 = 796,877,997 reproduces exactly in the 2013 Q1 filing's own 'January 2012 to' comparator).
